_schema: summit_county/campaign_finance vision cache v1 — COVER-PAGE STATED TOTALS ONLY (no donor itemization)
_column_contract: Summit's cover box runs Current | Last(=Previous, 2024 sheet) | Cumulative — the REVERSE of the parsed cities' sheet. All three columns are captured VERBATIM and LABELLED here; the builder promotes one per the rule documented in CLAUDE.md. "" = the cell was EMPTY (or a slashed-zero / dash nil mark) on the form; null = a value is present but ILLEGIBLE and was never guessed.
method: vision via the Read tool on a pdftoppm -jpeg -r 200 render of page 1 cropped to the top 80% ($0 API; Claude Code allotment)
notes: Typed cover, all three columns printed.

contributions.note: self-funding - the donor is the candidate. Verified at 900 dpi tight crop; P.O. box discarded per the privacy contract.

_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: exact - one row of 254.00 equals the page's printed >$50 box AND the cover's 254.00. This is a split50 sheet but NO structural residual arises: the <=$50 aggregate box is printed as an explicit $0.00, so the >$50 itemization is the entire stated total.

expenditures.detail: exact - one row of 254.00 equals the page's printed 'Total amount of expenditures $254.00' and the cover

_meta_itemized.page_gates: p2's split50 pair is filled on BOTH sides: 'more than $50' = $254.00 and '$50 or less' = $0.00, so the itemization is the whole of the contribution total. The single row reproduces the >$50 box to the cent. p3 prints 'Total amount of expenditures $254.00' and its single row reproduces it. Cover 254.00 / 254.00 / balance 0.00 agrees with both pages.

geometry.basis: rule-detection row banding (rowbands.py) on the page's own printed grid; box spans the full table width of the row

_meta_itemized.notes: A SHORT-GRID variant of the 2018 form: instead of ~36 empty rows, this sheet prints only 6 contribution bands and 4 expense bands, so the row-band count itself is a tight check (1 filled + the rest empty). Fully TYPED with a faithful OCR layer; both pages read full-page at 200 dpi and the contribution row re-read on a 900 dpi tight crop as the geometry spot-check (reproduced '3/9/18 | Christopher F. Robinson | ... Park City, UT | 84098 | $254.00'). No template specimen rows. Every page carries a printed footer block with the candidate's name and mailing address and 'Date Printed: 10/19/18' - a genuine print-date, not a transaction date, and not transcribed as one. THE WHOLE CAMPAIGN IS ONE SELF-FUNDING TRANSACTION: the candidate contributed $254.00 to himself on 3/9/18 and paid exactly that to the Summit County Clerk as the filing fee the same day, closing to a zero balance. Privacy: the Mailing Address column carries a P.O. box, which is discarded at read time - only city/state are retained.
